title: Sponsor a cat
intro: Can't adopt right now? You can still change a cat's month. Pick a cat and cover one of their needs: treatment, vaccines, food, litter or diapers. When it's covered, its icon lights up.
bills_intro: Some of our costs are shared by all the cats. You can cover one of them, all of it or part of it.

bills.title: Diapers & care
bills.note: Diapers, wet wipes and creams for all our paralyzed cats

bills.title: Litter
bills.note: Clean litter for every cat in our care

bills.title: Food bill
bills.note: Medical food and regular food. Cover all or part of what we still owe

bills.title: Clinic bill
bills.note: Our open balance at the vet. Cover all or part of it

bills.title: Grooming
bills.note: Brushing, baths and shaving for our long-haired cats

bills.title: Flea treatment
bills.note: Flea drops for every cat, every month

suppliers_note: We buy our food from Club 4 Paws, Optimeal, Royal Canin and Purina.
